Hesychius: ὑπόσκοπον χέρα [hand under which one looks]: Aeschylus (fr. 73) commands to shape the hand like those who look out, just as they make the Pans. The σκοπός [lookout] is a dance figure. On which see Salmasius on Scr. Hist. Aug. vol. 2 p. 836, and compare what has been said on fr. 73.
